answer: Price each identity to a slowly maturing bond anchored to one scarce external key, growing as patiently as cedar. Reward unlocks only after several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign its audited work, chiselling standing onto a narrow ledge no clone can widen. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so it bends like willow but roots nowhere: its endorsements never span distinct clusters, the bond stays locked. A farm buys a distinct cross-cluster anchor per head (linear); the honest agent pays once.
